user.title: Action Control
user.description: Set up Action Control. You will define watchdog rules afterwards, from the integration's Configure button.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Action Control is already configured; only one instance is needed.

add_rule.title: Rule – what to watch
add_rule.description: Choose which domain(s) this rule watches, and which entities it applies to. The next step lets you pick the services to watch within these domains.

add_rule_services.title: Rule – which services
add_rule_services.description: Services actually available for {domains} are suggested below; leave empty to watch every service in these domains, or type a service name that isn't listed.

data.services: Services (empty = any service in the domain)

rule_features.title: Rule – what it should do
rule_features.description: Pick what this rule uses. The next steps only ask for the settings these choices actually need.

data.escalation_enabled: Run a recovery action when it keeps failing
data.log_entity_info: Log a summary (entity, outcome, response time) for this rule at info level
data.notify_service: Also notify via this notify service

rule_verify.title: Rule – verification & retries
rule_verify.description: Define how the outcome is checked and how retries are handled.

data.attributes_to_check: Attributes to check (in addition to state)
data.change_attribute: Attribute to watch for a change (e.g. current_position)

rule_escalation.title: Rule – recovery action
rule_escalation.description: The recovery action (e.g. turning on a switch, or running a script) to run when verification keeps failing.

data.escalation_replay_delay: Delay after escalation before replaying the command (seconds)
data.escalation_check_enabled: Verify the recovery action worked before replaying the command

rule_escalation_check.title: Rule – verifying the recovery action
rule_escalation_check.description: The recovery action is re-run, using this rule's retry count and delay growth, until this entity reaches the expected state. The original command is replayed either way.

data.escalation_check_entity_id: Entity to verify after the recovery action

delete_rule_confirm.title: Confirm deletion
delete_rule_confirm.description: Delete rule "{rule_name}"? This cannot be undone.

data.default_retries: Default number of retries for new rules
data.default_retry_delay: Default delay between retries for new rules (seconds)

error.invalid_tolerances: Tolerances must be written as attribute:value, separated by commas (e.g. brightness:5, rgb_color:5).
error.domains_required: Pick at least one domain — a rule with no domain never matches anything.
error.change_attribute_required: Movement mode needs an attribute to watch (e.g. current_position).
error.escalation_check_required: Verifying the recovery action needs both an entity and the state it should reach.

abort.no_rules: No rule has been configured yet.

options.delay: Delay — wait, then compare state and attributes
options.movement: Movement — wait for an attribute to actually start changing (covers, ...)

run_rule.name: Run rule
run_rule.description: Test a rule on demand: re-issues the given service on the entity and lets the rule verify it, exactly as if the service had been called normally.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: The entity to test the rule against.

service_data.name: Service data
service_data.description: Data for the service call. Include a "service" key to override the rule's default service.

reset_escalation_cooldown.name: Reset escalation cooldown
reset_escalation_cooldown.description: Clear a rule's escalation cooldown so it can escalate again immediately.

stale_target.title: Action Control: rule targets a missing area, label, or device
stale_target.description: Rule "{rule}" targets one or more areas, labels, or devices that no longer exist. It won't match anything until you update or remove that target in the rule's targeting step.
